prompt_head: You extract what a client asks for from a Request for Proposal (RFP), so a propo
text:
{
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "r1", "label": "Organizational Change Disclosure", "rfpQuote": "Has there been a recent change in organizational structure (e.g., management team) or control", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r2", "label": "Company History Discussion", "rfpQuote": "Discuss your company’s history. Has growth been organic, through mergers and acquisitions, or both?", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r3", "label": "Debarment and Suspension Disclosure", "rfpQuote": "Has bidder ever been debarred, suspended, or disqualified from bidding or contracting with any entity", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r4", "label": "Litigation History Disclosure", "rfpQuote": "Has your company been a party to litigation against the State of Michigan?", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r5", "label": "Contract Default History", "rfpQuote": "Within the last 5 years, has your company or any of its related business entities defaulted on a contract", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r6", "label": "Gross Annual Sales Reporting", "rfpQuote": "State your gross annual sales for each of the last 5 years.", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r7", "label": "Scale-Up Management Plan", "rfpQuote": "explain how the company will scale-up to manage this increase.", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r8", "label": "Primary Physical Address", "rfpQuote": "State the physical address of the place of business that would have primary responsibility for this account", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r9", "label": "Contract Terms Affirmation", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must affirm agreement with the attached Contract Terms.", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r10", "label": "Schedule C Insurance Affirmation", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must affirm agreement with the attached Schedule C (Insurance Requirements).", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r11", "label": "Labor and Environmental Disclosures", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must disclose any violations of state or federal labor, antidiscrimination and employment laws and regulations", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r12", "label": "Environmental Law Violation Disclosure", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must disclose any violations of state or federal environmental laws and regulations received within thepast fiveyears.", "section": "§1"},
    {"id": "r13", "label": "Host Environment Disclosure", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must disclose if it is proposing a Contractor Hosted or State Hosted application.", "section": "§3"},
    {"id": "r14", "label": "Voluntary Product Accessibility Template", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must provide a description of conformance with World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines", "section": "§4"},
    {"id": "r15", "label": "PAT Conformance Plan", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must provide detailed information regarding the plan to achieve conformance, including timelines.", "section": "§4"},
    {"id": "r16", "label": "Concurrent User Capacity Explanation", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must explain how it will be able to support the expected number of concurrent Users.", "section": "§5.1"},
    {"id": "r17", "label": "Access Control Integration Plan", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must explain how they will meet the requirements for Access Control and Authentication.", "section": "§6"},
    {"id": "r18", "label": "Data Retention and Retrieval Explanation", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must review and explain how the data retention, disposal, and retrieval requirements will be met", "section": "§7"},
    {"id": "r19", "label": "Optimal Operating Environment Description", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must describe the optimal IT environment, including any applicable hosting environments, supported browsers and user interfaces.", "section": "§8"},
    {"id": "r20", "label": "Software Bill of Materials", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must provide a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) containing details and supply chain relationships", "section": "§9"},
    {"id": "r21", "label": "Detailed Solution Architecture Description", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must provide a detailed description of the Solution to be provided under the resulting Contract", "section": "§9"},
    {"id": "r22", "label": "AI Usage Disclosure", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must identify and describe the use of artificial intelligence (AI) within or used to develop the Solution.", "section": "§9"},
    {"id": "r23", "label": "MiLogin Integration Plan", "rfpQuote": "Bidder must review and explain how the Solution will integrate to this system.", "section": "§9"},
    {"id": "r24", "label": "Administration and End-User Training", "rfpQuote": "The Contractor must provide administration and end-user training for implementation, go-live support, and operational handoff.", "section": "§12"},
    {"id": "r25", "label": "Go-Live Training Plan", "rfpQuote": "The Bidder must provide a training plan for go-live support and transition to self-support", "section": "§12"},
    {"id": "r26", "label": "Comprehensive Solution Documentation", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must provide all user manuals, operating manuals, technical manuals and any other instructions", "section": "§13"},
    {"id": "r27", "label": "Designated Contractor Key Personnel", "rfpQuote": "Contractor resource who is responsible to respond to State inquiries regarding the security of the Contractor’s Solution.", "section": "§16"},
    {"id": "r28", "label": "Kick-Off and Implementation Meetings", "rfpQuote": "Contractor Project Manager must facilitate a project kick off meeting with the support from the State’s Project Manager", "section": "§19"},
    {"id": "r29", "label": "Weekly Project Progress Reporting", "rfpQuote": "Contractor Project Manager will monitor project implementation progress and report on a weekly basis to the State’s Project Manager", "section": "§20"},
    {"id": "r30", "label": "Clarity PPM Timesheet Entry", "rfpQuote": "All Contractors must submit and enter weekly timesheets into the State of Michigan’s Project Portfolio Management tool, Clarity PPM", "section": "§20"},
    {"id": "r31", "label": "SUITE Methodology Review", "rfpQuote": "The Bidder is required to review https://www.michigan.gov/suite and demonstrate how each PMM/SEM requirement will be met.", "section": "§21"},
    {"id": "r32", "label": "Business Specifications Worksheet Completion", "rfpQuote": "Contractors must respond to each business Specification on how they will meet the requirements in the document provided.", "section": "§22"},
    {"id": "r33", "label": "Role-Based Access Permissions Specification", "rfpQuote": "The solution must allow for multiple roles with varying permissions.", "section": "§22"},
    {"id": "r34", "label": "Public Employer Directory Specification", "rfpQuote": "The solution must provide a public- facing searchable, filterable, directory of validated employers.", "section": "§22"},
    {"id": "r35", "label": "Flexible Integration Endpoints Specification", "rfpQuote": "The application be designed with flexible architecture to support future integration endpoints as needed.", "section": "§22"},
    {"id": "r36", "label": "Security Model and Rights Management", "rfpQuote": "The application must maintain a security model to define, manage, and control (e.g., add, assign, revoke) user rights", "section": "§22"},
    {"id": "r37", "label": "System Error Logging and Alerts", "rfpQuote": "The application must log all errors and send notifications that include severity, date/time,", "section": "§22"}
  ],
  "constraints": [
    {"id": "c1", "kind": "DEADLINE", "label": "Contract Base Term", "rfpQuote": "Term of the Agreement: 5 Base Years with 5, 1-Year Options.", "section": "§3"},
    {"id": "c2", "kind": "TECHNOLOGY", "label": "WCAG Accessibility Compliance", "rfpQuote": "All websites, applications, software, and associated content and documentation provided by the Contractor as part of the Solution must comply", "section": "§4"},
    {"id": "c3", "kind": "OTHER", "label": "Concurrent User Capacity Minimums", "rfpQuote": "Contractor Solution must meet the expected number of concurrent Users below:", "section": "§5.1"},
    {"id": "c4", "kind": "TECHNOLOGY", "label": "Mandatory MiLogin Integration", "rfpQuote": "The Contractor’s solution must implement identity federation with the State’s MiLogin IT Identity and Access Management (IAM) environment", "section": "§6"},
    {"id": "c5", "kind": "TECHNOLOGY", "label": "Federated Identity Protocols", "rfpQuote": "the Contractor’s solution must support SAML, OpenID Connect (ODIC) federated identity protocols.", "section": "§6"},
    {"id": "c6", "kind": "LEGAL", "label": "State Data Retention and Disposal", "rfpQuote": "Except as otherwise stated in the Contract, Contractor will not dispose of, delete, or destroy State Data without the prior written approval", "section": "§7"},
    {"id": "c7", "kind": "TECHNOLOGY", "label": "Browser Compatibility Standards", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must ensure applications and websites display and function accurately in, at minimum, the two most recent major versions", "section": "§8"},
    {"id": "c8", "kind": "BUDGET", "label": "Standard Environment Cost Constraint", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must support the current and future State standard environment at no additional cost to the State.", "section": "§8"},
    {"id": "c9", "kind": "TECHNOLOGY", "label": "SOM Look and Feel Compliance", "rfpQuote": "All software items provided by the Contractor must adhere to the State of Michigan Application/Site standards", "section": "§9"},
    {"id": "c10", "kind": "LEGAL", "label": "Domestic Geographic Access Restriction", "rfpQuote": "Contractor will not access State environments or State Systems from locations outside the United States or the jurisdiction territories", "section": "§9"},
    {"id": "c11", "kind": "LEGAL", "label": "Prohibition of Offshore Resources", "rfpQuote": "Use of Offshore Resources is prohibited per the Schedule E – Data Security Requirements.", "section": "§17"},
    {"id": "c12", "kind": "BUDGET", "label": "Mandatory Meeting Cost Inclusion", "rfpQuote": "The Contractor must attend the following meetings, at a location and time as identified by the State, at no additional cost", "section": "§19"},
    {"id": "c13", "kind": "OTHER", "label": "Business Worksheet Alteration Prohibition", "rfpQuote": "Contractor must not alter the document.", "section": "§22"},
    {"id": "c14", "kind": "OTHER", "label": "Business Specification Word Count Cap", "rfpQuote": "Description must be no more than 250 words for each business Specification.", "section": "§22"}
  ],
  "suggestedWeights": [
    {"criterionId": "problem_understanding", "weight": 1.4, "reason": "The RFP emphasizes compliance with the Youth Employment Standards Act and transitioning from a legacy paper process to a statewide portal."},
    {"criterionId": "scope_clarity", "weight": 1.5, "reason": "Detailed functional expectations are captured across numerous business specifications and operational worksheets that must be clearly delimited."},
    {"criterionId": "pricing_clarity", "weight": 1.2, "reason": "Explicit constraints prohibit additional costs for supporting future environments and mandatory meetings over a 5-year base term."},
    {"criterionId": "timeline_clarity", "weight": 1.3, "reason": "Specific reporting on milestone variances with graded severity triggers necessitates clearly planned implementation and go-live schedules."},
    {"criterionId": "tone_persuasiveness", "weight": 0.8, "reason": "The solicitation strictly prioritizes compliance, factual verifications, and exact technical capabilities over marketing tone."},
    {"criterionId": "risk_transparency", "weight": 1.4, "reason": "Extensive disclosures are mandated regarding contract defaults, litigation, offshore resources, and impact risks of proposed configurations or customizations."},
    {"criterionId": "completeness", "weight": 1.5, "reason": "Every business specification in the worksheet must be individually completed without altering the template, under strict word count limits."}
  ]
}
